description: Score a URL for phishing patterns: homoglyph/IDN look-alikes, brand tokens in subdomains, IP-literal hosts, @-tricks, excessive length/hyphens/depth, high-abuse TLDs, punycode and non-standard ports. Pure analysis of the string itself — the pre-click check for links from emails, QR codes or chat. Use this when an agent needs to risk-score a URL before clicking or calling it. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_phishing_heuristics
title: Phishing URL Heuristics
